paletteRule: Brightness31 before Blue channel expansion; encoded OAM palette when flags2 bit0x400 is set, otherwise the selected effect palette. Bank14 is effect-owned, banks0–13 use native AX palettes.
layerRule: Separate source depth offsets, with first source piece foremost within equal depth. The battle renderer interleaves each layer with actor depth.
waitRule: Literal effect_data.unk20 becomes effect_main.unk54. A nonzero flag makes sub_800E9A8 return false immediately; TRUE global drains still include the artwork tail.
